scenicChapters.title: Luxembourg Mullerthal Route
scenicChapters.narrative: For 53 km this is Luxembourg Mullerthal Route, a road with a name of its own and a reason for it — expect company on a summer weekend. Early is better than fast.

scenicChapters.title: Luxembourg Mullerthal Route
scenicChapters.narrative: Water arrives beside the road and stays for 38 km. The line follows the shore because there is nowhere else for it to go. Slow enough to look. The surface follows the shoreline, so the corners arrive where the water decided, not where an engineer did.

places-las-cazuelas-abrigo-del-melgar.story: From Moratalla it runs 337 km to Moratalla; allow about 5 h 49 of riding. The stops in between: molino de las fuentes I, Letreros de los mártires, Cañada de la Cruz and Abrigo del.melgar. The highest point is about 1,400 m. It was put together for the scenery rather than the shortest line.
